description: An empty shopping bag state with sign-in and shopping actions above a row of recommended products.
overview: An empty shopping bag state with a short message, Sign In and Continue Shopping buttons and a row of recommended products. Adding a recommendation updates the bag icon's count and switches the message and primary action to a checkout state. Recommendations sit in one column on mobile and three on larger screens. Use it for empty carts, wish lists or saved-items screens.
usage: Replace `recommended` with products from your recommendation service, each with a name, formatted price and image. Swap the local add toggle for your cart logic, and connect Sign In, Check Out and Continue Shopping to your routes.
notes: Add buttons expose their pressed state and name the product. Product photos are Unsplash placeholders.
